description: Unmodified historical and camera-ready analysis inputs/outputs; gzip transport only. Includes all data inputs for scripts/75_all_core_results.py plus campaign JSON metadata and the mechanism CSV. Run scripts/release.py restore. Model weights and full auxiliary lens banks are not redistributed.
